name: Caring Brands Inc. Common Stock
summary: Caring Brands, Inc. operates as a consumer wellness company, offering a varied collection of over-the-counter (OTC) and cosmetic merchandise. Its extensive product catalog features items such as hair loss treatments, solutions for eczema and psoriasis, vitiligo remedies, a specialized sun protection line that defends against jellyfish stings, and intimate health products for women. All these offerings are crafted to fulfill a wide array of health and personal care requirements. The firm was founded in 2020 and is based in Jupiter, Florida.
